name: Full Test Recipe
description: Complete recipe with all available fields for testing purposes
yamlContent:
recipe:
  name: "Full Test Recipe"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Complete recipe with all available fields for testing purposes"

parameters:
  input_path: "./data/input"
  output_path: "./data/output"
  max_retries: 3
  timeout: 300

env:
  NODE_ENV: "production"
  DEBUG: "false"
  API_URL: "https://api.example.com"

targets:
  - name: "production"
    agents_path: "/opt/agents"
    scripts_path: "/opt/scripts"
    cli: "opencode"
  - name: "staging"
    agents_path: "/staging/agents"
    scripts_path: "/staging/scripts"
    cli: "copilot"

projects:
  - id: "project-001"
    name: "Main Project"
    description: "Primary project for data processing"
    path: "/projects/main"
    target: "production"
    status: "active"
    readme: "This is the main project README"
    agents:
      - "agent-001"
      - "agent-002"
    scripts:
      - "script-001"
      - "script-002"

agents:
  - id: "agent-001"
    name: "Data Processor"
    namespace: "processing"
    category: "transform"
    description: "Agent responsible for data transformation"
    prompt: "You are a data processing agent that transforms input data into structured output."
    path: "/agents/data-processor"
  - id: "agent-002"
    name: "Validator"
    namespace: "validation"
    category: "quality"
    description: "Agent for validating data integrity"
    prompt: "You are a validation agent that ensures data quality and integrity."
    path: "/agents/validator"

scripts:
  - id: "script-001"
    name: "pre-process.sh"
    namespace: "utils"
    category: "preprocessing"
    description: "Preprocessing script for data cleanup"
    content: "#!/bin/bash\necho 'Running preprocessing...'"
    scope: "global"
    path: "/scripts/pre-process.sh"
  - id: "script-002"
    name: "post-process.py"
    namespace: "utils"
    category: "postprocessing"
    description: "Postprocessing script for results"
    content: "import sys\nprint('Postprocessing complete')"
    scope: "project"
    path: "/scripts/post-process.py"

templates:
  - id: "template-001"
    name: "Agent Template"
    type: "agents"
    description: "Template for creating new agents"
    template: "agent-template-v1"
  - id: "template-002"
    name: "Script Template"
    type: "scripts"
    description: "Template for creating new scripts"
    template: "script-template-v1"

pipelines:
  - id: "pipeline-001"
    project: "project-001"
    name: "Data Processing Pipeline"
    description: "Main data processing workflow"
    type: "sequential"
    output_extension: ".json"
    steps:
      - order: 1
        agent: "agent-001"
        prompt: "Process the input data files"
        type: "agent"
        runtime: "node"
        cli: "opencode"
        parameters: "--verbose"
        arguments: "input.json"
        input:
          content: "Raw input data"
          type: "text"
        output:
          content: "Processed data"
          type: "json"
      - order: 2
        script: "script-001"
        type: "script"
        runtime: "cmd"
        cli: "opencode"
        parameters: "--output=result.json"
        arguments: "step1.json"
        input:
          content: "processed.json"
          type: "json"
        output:
          content: "final_result.json"
          type: "json"
      - order: 3
        agent: "agent-002"
        prompt: "Validate the final results"
        type: "agent"
        runtime: "node"

tasks:
  - id: "task-001"
    type: "create"
    resource: "agent"
    ref: "agent-template-001"
    depends_on: []
    pipeline_ref: "pipeline-001"
    pipeline_id: "12345"
    pipeline_name: "Data Processing Pipeline"
    project: "project-001"
    repeat: "1"
    retry:
      max_attempts: "3"
      delay_seconds: "10"
      on_status:
        - "failed"
        - "error"
    loop:
      condition: "always"
      max_iterations: "5"
      delay_seconds: "2"
    wait: false
    stop_on_failure: true
  - id: "task-002"
    type: "run"
    resource: "pipeline"
    ref: "pipeline-001"
    depends_on:
      - "task-001"
    pipeline_id: "12345"
    pipeline_name: "Data Processing Pipeline"
    project: "project-001"
    wait: true
    stop_on_failure: false
  - id: "task-003"
    type: "call"
    resource: "script"
    ref: "script-001"
    depends_on:
      - "task-002"
    project: "project-001"
    wait: false
    stop_on_failure: true
